messages:
Sam Lee: Polychain reached out: they see the same session billed twice — once in us-west and once in eu-central. total overcharge ~200k tokens. Can eng confirm if replication caused double writes to the ledger?
Nora Brooks: Which timeframe/org id?
Sam Lee: org=polychain, window 2026-07-02T03:10-03:25 UTC. Attached example session ids.
Diego Morales: I checked the ingestion trace. We have a geo-replicated writer that writes local copies and also an async replication stream. For a subset of sessions the replication consumer and local writer both committed before the global dedupe marker was applied. Sample lines: 
{"ts":"2026-07-02T03:12:04Z","region":"us-west","req_id":"pc_sess_77a","status":200,"tokens":1000}
{"ts":"2026-07-02T03:12:05Z","region":"eu-central","req_id":"pc_sess_77a","status":200,"tokens":1000}
Diego Morales: Because dedupe runs per-region shard the global dedupe key wasn't enforced, so both events landed in the ledger as separate billable events.
Nora Brooks: Quick aggregate?
Diego Morales: SQL on billing_mirror: SELECT sum(tokens) as tokens_billed FROM metering_ledger WHERE org='polychain' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-07-02T03:10:00Z' AND '2026-07-02T03:25:00Z'; -- result: 1,200,000 tokens. After de-duping by req_id across regions tokens_if_unique = 1,000,000 tokens. Delta = 200,000 tokens (~$20.00 at their tier).
Aisha Khan: Finance: do we approve a one-time ledger correction + customer credit for $20? We'll need dry-run CSV, checksum, and engineering plan to enforce global dedupe during replication.
Nora Brooks: Approve the correction and credit pending dry-run artifacts. :white_check_mark:
billing-bot: Automated precheck: replication-backfill requires (1) snapshot export (2) cross-region dry-run CSV + md5 (3) finance approval.
Diego Morales: I'll run the dry-run that collapses identical req_id across regions into single canonical event and produce a CSV with before/after rows + md5. ETA 3 hours. Also opening ENG ticket ENG-7032 to add a global dedupe marker at the replication commit path.
Sam Lee: Draft customer note: "We traced duplicate charges to a replication race where the same request was written from two regions before global deduplication ran. We'll correct the ledger and apply a one-time credit of $20.00; attached CSV and audit checksum. Apologies." Approve?
Nora Brooks: Approve wording. Please CC accounting and attach dry-run when ready.
Aisha Khan: After commit, please add a short postmortem and detection alert for cross-region duplicate writes.
Sam Lee: Will follow up once dry-run completes. Thanks team.
